reason: README's Ollama section runs LangExtract with local gemma2:2b (about 1.6 GB) on CPU with no API key.
demo: README 'Using Local LLMs with Ollama' plus Quick Start extraction and visualization, with model_id gemma2:2b at http://localhost:11434
goal: Install langextract from source (pip install -e .) and Ollama, pull gemma2:2b, and serve it on localhost:11434. Create /work/run.sh to start the Ollama server and block until it is ready (the model must be pulled). Create /work/env.sh to activate the Python environment. Then the README Romeo and Juliet example must run through lx.extract(model_id='gemma2:2b', model_url='http://localhost:11434') on the text 'Lady Juliet gazed longingly at the stars, her heart aching for Romeo'. Saving results to JSONL and generating the visualization HTML must also work.
check: A script calls lx.extract against the local Ollama server, then checks that it returns at least one extraction with grounded text, and that the JSONL and visualization HTML files are written.
